time.rationale: the report gives 00:30 to 01:00; the middle of it is taken, and it is the moment at which the report's own sky (Arcturus at azimuth 260, elevation 33) is right to the degree (22:45 UTC)

durationSeconds.rationale: the recording runs on the investigators' common clock (COBEPS report 20150712BraineleComte, table 2, T0 to T4 = 10 s); his own duration is 5 s, from his turning round (T2, 3 s) to 8 s

utcOffsetHours.rationale: Central European Summer Time on 2015-07-12; the report gives 22:30-23:00 UTC for 00:30-01:00

place.rationale: the report redacts the address and gives the place to a tenth of a degree only (50.6 N, 4.1 E, 89 m), a garden in a residential area near the Mons-Brussels railway

source.rationale: cognitive interview on 2016-01-23, six months after (BJN's and FWY's also; AKH also wrote a form on 2015-07-13)

followedUp.rationale: reconstruction on site, questions by e-mail in April 2016

description.fr: « [...] AKH a vu quelque chose et nous dit de regarder. Donc, le temps que je me retourne, et tout ça, je n'ai pas vu très longtemps, enfin deux ou trois secondes, une forme un peu plus noire que le ciel, mais il y avait des lumières orange, qui formaient, je vais faire une comparaison pour la forme : un boomerang. Donc, les lumières s'allumaient, comme une sorte de boomerang qui se dirigeait vers l'horizon. Et puis à un moment a disparu. » À l'entretien, il précise que l'ensemble était composé de cinq à sept sphères lumineuses orange, d'une luminosité uniforme et faible qu'il compare à du feu, régulièrement espacées, sur un support plus foncé que le ciel ; qu'il n'a pas fait attention à la forme mais à l'alignement ; qu'il ne s'éloignait pas quand il a disparu : il a dû cligner des yeux, et pendant ce clignement il n'y avait plus rien à observer.
description.en: “[...] AKH saw something and told us to look. So, by the time I turned round and all that, I did not see for very long, well two or three seconds, a shape a bit blacker than the sky, but there were orange lights, which formed, to make a comparison for the shape: a boomerang. So the lights came on, like a sort of boomerang heading for the horizon. And then at some point it disappeared.” At the interview he adds that it was made of five to seven orange luminous spheres, of uniform and faint brightness, which he compares to fire, evenly spaced on a support darker than the sky; that he paid attention not to the shape but to the alignment; that it was not moving away when it disappeared: he must have blinked, and during that blink there was nothing left to see.
description.es: «[...] AKH vio algo y nos dijo que miráramos. Así que, el tiempo de darme la vuelta y todo eso, no vi muy mucho, bueno dos o tres segundos, una forma un poco más negra que el cielo, pero había luces naranjas, que formaban, voy a hacer una comparación para la forma: un bumerán. O sea, las luces se encendían, como una especie de bumerán que se dirigía hacia el horizonte. Y luego en un momento desapareció.» En la entrevista precisa que el conjunto estaba compuesto de cinco a siete esferas luminosas naranjas, de luminosidad uniforme y débil que compara con fuego, espaciadas con regularidad, sobre un soporte más oscuro que el cielo; que no se fijó en la forma sino en la alineación; que no se alejaba cuando desapareció: debió de parpadear, y durante ese parpadeo ya no había nada que observar.
description.it: «[...] AKH ha visto qualcosa e ci ha detto di guardare. Quindi, il tempo di voltarmi e tutto il resto, non ho visto molto a lungo, insomma due o tre secondi, una forma un po' più nera del cielo, ma c'erano luci arancioni, che formavano, faccio un paragone per la forma: un boomerang. Quindi le luci si accendevano, come una specie di boomerang che si dirigeva verso l'orizzonte. E poi a un certo punto è scomparso.» All'intervista precisa che l'insieme era composto da cinque a sette sfere luminose arancioni, di luminosità uniforme e debole che paragona al fuoco, regolarmente distanziate, su un supporto più scuro del cielo; che non ha badato alla forma ma all'allineamento; che non si allontanava quando è scomparso: deve aver sbattuto le palpebre, e durante quel battito non c'era più nulla da osservare.

note.it: AKH dice di guardare: FWY guarda allora verso nord-nord-ovest.

note.fr: Il se retourne, de tout le corps : il voit à l'ouest, à 20° de hauteur, une forme plus noire que le ciel portée par des lumières orange.
note.en: He turns round, his whole body: he sees in the west, 20° up, a shape blacker than the sky carrying orange lights.
note.es: Se da la vuelta, con todo el cuerpo: ve al oeste, a 20° de altura, una forma más negra que el cielo con luces naranjas.
note.it: Si volta, con tutto il corpo: vede a ovest, a 20° di altezza, una forma più nera del cielo con luci arancioni.

note.fr: Elle disparaît « comme ça », à 12° de hauteur, pendant qu'il cligne des yeux.
note.en: It disappears “just like that”, 12° up, while he blinks.
note.es: Desaparece «así, de golpe», a 12° de altura, mientras parpadea.
note.it: Scompare «così», a 12° di altezza, mentre sbatte le palpebre.

track.rationale: The measured directions of the three observers (COBEPS report 20150712BraineleComte, table 1) are fitted by one plane through the observer, as the report's stereonet does (its strike here: 7.8 deg, the report's 7.7; dip 33 deg). The phenomenon is laid on the level line where that plane is 100 m up, along each of FWY's own directions brought onto the plane. The height is BJN's own estimate (COBEPS p. 13), and so the distances and the 10.5 m span that follow from it: assumed.

title.en: A flock of 7 birds in a V, 40 m up, lit from below (a hypothesis the report does not examine)
title.es: Una bandada de 7 aves en V a 40 m, iluminadas desde abajo (hipótesis que el informe no examina)
title.it: Uno stormo di 7 uccelli a V a 40 m, illuminati dal basso (ipotesi che il rapporto non esamina)

track.rationale: A flock of 7 birds in a V 4.2 m across, flying the same straight level flight as the fitted one (see that interpretation) but 40 m up: the speed it needs there is about 80 km/h, a goose's or a duck's, where at 100 m it would be 200 km/h. Each bird 0.9 m across (a duck's wings) and lit from below, dark. None of it is stated by the report, which does not examine this hypothesis.
